name: skillroster
description: Inspect and govern local Skills: inventory, usage evidence, duplicates, broken links, Core/On-demand proposals, Plans, Receipts, Apply, and Undo. Also find a specialized local Skill when the user requests one or the task would benefit from instructions beyond the visible catalog. Ordinary work can proceed with the Agent's existing capabilities. Not for installing third-party Skills or migrating, distributing, synchronizing, or repairing shared Skill-manager directories.
